assessments.reasoning: The pinned publisher file and its recomputed digest match the edition. The slice starts at the Chu line and ends immediately after the disclaimer LF, before the blank line and following separator. [Pinned OpenLDAP COPYRIGHT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openldap/openldap/b9c1d8f93d7a532b6b17a32b52dfc14530e139f7/COPYRIGHT)

The pinned JSON passed the envelope length and SHA-256 checks. Its licenseId is Furuseth and its decoded licenseText equals the publisher slice byte for byte. [SPDX Furuseth detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/Furuseth.json)

The pinned Furuseth.txt passed the envelope length and SHA-256 checks. All 626 bytes, including the final LF, equal the publisher slice. [SPDX Furuseth text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/Furuseth.txt)

The digest-checked SPDX repository API response identifies annotated tag v3.29.0 and points to commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, which appears in both Furuseth artifact routes. [SPDX annotated tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Extracted the complete contributor block, retained the final LF, decoded JSON licenseText, and tested exact equality for both SPDX representations. Also tested whole-file equality and checked the tag object and identifier paths.
challenge.results: Publisher bytes [1223, 1849) are exactly equal to both 626-byte SPDX representations. Whole-file equality fails because COPYRIGHT contains additional material. Both SPDX paths are pinned to the annotated tag's target and the detail declares Furuseth.

limitations: The comparison covers the specified contributor notice and SPDX data release only. The API records the tag as unsigned, so provenance rests on the pinned repository routes and connector capture.
reasoning: The exact publisher passage, named SPDX identifier, and annotated release target jointly support the claimed byte correspondence.
